summary: Broad human pancreas coverage is plausible, but expected mast-cell and lymphatic-endothelial populations are missing and the immune gate is too myeloid/APC-biased.

issues.description: Mast cells are an expected resident immune population in human pancreas atlases, but the blueprint only resolves macrophage/monocyte, dendritic/APC, T/NK, and B/plasma immune compartments.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a mast-cell gene module with canonical markers such as KIT, TPSAB1, TPSB2, CPA3, MS4A2, HDC, GATA2, and add a leukocyte-gated mast-cell axis.

issues.description: The endothelial module is blood-vascular biased and does not resolve lymphatic endothelium, which belongs in the healthy pancreas tissue landscape.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a lymphatic endothelial module/axis, preferably gated by broad endothelial identity, using markers such as PROX1, PDPN, LYVE1, FLT4, CCL21, MMRN1, and TFF3 where supported.

issues.description: leukocyte_common is not truly pan-leukocyte: LST1, HLA class II genes, CD74, and TYROBP bias the gate toward myeloid/APC/B cells and can under-score T, NK, and mast cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the gate genes with pan-leukocyte markers such as PTPRC, LCP1, CORO1A, LAPTM5, CD52, CD53, RAC2; keep HLA/TYROBP markers in macrophage or dendritic/APC modules.

issues.description: Pericytes/smooth muscle and endothelial cells are neighboring vascular compartments rather than opposing programs, and endothelial identity already has its own plain axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Change this to a plain pericyte_smooth_muscle axis, or gate a mural-cell axis by a broad vascular/stromal context instead of contrasting directly against endothelium.

issues.description: The current lymphoid modules combine distinct T versus NK and B versus plasma populations, reducing resolution for expected immune subtypes in human pancreas.
issues.suggested_fix: If dimensionality permits, split into separate T-cell, NK-cell, B-cell, and plasma-cell modules/axes; otherwise keep broad lymphoid axes but make the aggregation explicit and avoid marker mixtures that blur the score.

out_of_scope: DOI correctness and exact citation-to-marker verification were not checked in this discriminator pass.
